svg.title: macOS · Photo viewer / grading editor · Editor tab · Light › High · Wh · 1000×700
svg.desc: Mirrors App/PhotoViewerView.swift — the grading editor in its own resizable window (PhotoEditorWindowRequest scene in LetsLapseApp; default 1000×700 drawn here, min 720×480; the window chrome owns title and close, so there is no in-content back button or Done bar). REBUILT 2026-09-13 around the editor-controls redesign (Claude Design handoff “LetsLapse Editor slider organization”, boards 3b · 6c; spec sections 1–5, 9, 10): the seven-section always-open panel is gone; the grade is five GROUPS + Presets (App/EditorControls/EditorGroup.swift — Light: Exp · Con / High · Wh / Shad · Bl; Color: WB / Vib · Sat / Mixer; Effects: Tex · Clar / Vignette / Dehaze; Detail: Sharpen / Noise; Crop: aspect chips + Angle), each opened from a main button into ONE card of tool chips over an XY PAD (App/EditorControls/XYPad.swift) with two readouts, and closed by Revert (restores the snapshot taken when the panel opened) or Done (keeps). THIS FILE is board 3b on a PHOTO capture: no timeline, so the media pane takes the whole 669×672 column (the 4:3 picture fitted to the width, 669×502, centred), no INTERVAL badge, no strip, and the tab pill has three segments (Frames exists only for interval shoots). Open: Light › High · Wh — Highlights −27 on the pad's Y axis (Lift up / Recover down), Whites on X (Whites − / Whites +), the highWhites gradient #3A3A3E → #C8C8CC bottom to top; the readouts read “Highlights −27” in black (moved) and “Whites 0” in #6D6D72 (neutral); the Light dot is lit on the main button and in the card header, so Reset shows. RAIL (3b / 6c): a FIXED 330 pt rail (railWidth, macOS) right of a hairline Divider — resizing the window grows the picture, never the controls. On the Editor page the whole rail scrolls, tab pill included: padding 14 top / 16 sides / 20 bottom, 12 between items. Top to bottom: (1) RailTabBar as a white capsule (padding 3, equal segments 2 apart, 13 pt semibold, the selected segment LL.accent with a white label) — Editor · Text · Frames · Masks, Frames only where frames do (availableRailTabs); (2) EditorGroupBar .macCard — a white card padded 6 holding six 46 pt cells spread edge to edge: 18 pt SF Symbol (photo.stack, sun.max, circle.lefthalf.filled, sparkles, triangle, crop.rotate), 9.5 pt semibold label, a 4 pt dot lit when the group holds a value or a travelling field, idle ink #6D6D72, the OPEN group on LL.accent 12 % with accent ink; a tap opens that group's panel and snapshots the grade, a tap on the open group leaves it open — closing is the panel's Revert / Done; (3) the open group's PhotoAdjustmentsPanel as a white radius-12 card padded 12 with 10 between rows: the header (title 13.5 semibold #6D6D72, the 6 pt dot when non-neutral, then Reset in accent text while non-neutral, the Revert pill #E9E9EB and the Done pill LL.accent, both 12 pt semibold, 23 tall, radius 7 — Done keeps the values and drops the snapshot, Revert restores it, both close), then the group's content; (4) MasksCard on its compact rows; (5) “Reset adjustments” 13 pt semibold accent, 4 in from the rail's content edge — and nothing after it: the inline “Save these edits as a preset?” offer (the window chrome owns the exit, so the offer cannot intercept one; not on the boards) lives in the Presets card's footer alone since 2026-09-13, where it takes the place of the “Save as Preset” row while the state is Edited and the offer has not been declined (`presetsFooter`: either the owner's offer or the row, never both); the rail foot that used to repeat it is gone. Group card 62 tall at y=110; the panel card starts at y=184. TOOL CHIPS (EditorToolChips .light): one row, every chip the same width across the 274 pt card content, 6 apart, 30 tall, radius 9 — 18 pt EditorToolIcon (the handoff's icon set, drawn in SwiftUI), 11 pt semibold label (Exp · Con, High · Wh, Shad · Bl / WB, Vib · Sat, Mixer / Tex · Clar, Vignette, Dehaze / Sharpen, Noise), idle fill #F2F2F7 with #1C1C1E ink, the selected chip LL.accent 12 % with a 1.5 pt accent border and accent label; the label shrinks to 75 % before it truncates. The selection persists per group for the session. PAD (spec §2, XYPad .light): 274×170, radius 10, the crosshair at BOTH axes' neutral (black 25 %), a 24 pt LL.accent knob with a 2.5 pt white ring, the axis words 10 pt semibold white with a shadow inset 6 top / bottom and 8 at the sides; a drag writes both fields through the one binding in one write per tick, a double-click resets both (through the timeline where there is one); Tab focuses the pad and the arrow keys step it. Under it PadReadouts, 11.5 pt semibold: label #6D6D72, value black once moved, #6D6D72 at neutral, ACCENT when the field travels — with the 7 pt diamond (LL.amber, 1 pt LL.accent border, rotated 45°) after a travelling field's label and on a tool chip when either of its fields travels (treatment 1e-A). Settings › Advanced › Layout › “Use Pads in Editor” off (or LL_PADS=off) replaces every pad with its two slider rows, Y field first. MASKS CARD (MasksCard, compactRows — the Mac's default): “Masks · 1 applied · Manage ›” over one row per grade: a 44×36 tile, the name 13.5 semibold, “Radial · enabled” 11 pt, then the TOOL ICONS of the tools the grade moves at full ink (WB, Exp · Con here) plus one dimmed (35 %) lead icon for every section it leaves alone (Vib · Sat for Color, Tex · Clar for Effects), and a chevron; a click expands the grade under the rows (photo-viewer.mask-grade.svg), Manage › switches the rail to the Masks tab. STATES NOT DRAWN (desc-only): the group card with nothing open (the panel card is simply absent — photo-viewer.mask-grade.svg draws it); the header's Reset absent while the group is neutral; a dark-appearance window (the inks are semantic — LL.cardBackground, .primary / .secondary — so the same layout reads right there); the rail's overlay scroller while the content outruns 672 pt; the pads-off variant (every pad becomes its two slider rows, Y field first — LL_PADS=off); the stacked layout below 500 pt. DEVIATIONS FROM BOARD 3b, drawn as shipped: the header carries a Reset text button between the dot and Revert (spec §3 keeps the Mac's header Reset); the inline “Save these edits as a preset?” card no longer follows “Reset adjustments” (removed 2026-09-13 — it had doubled the Presets card's own offer; the board draws no offer), so the rail ends at Reset adjustments. Hooks: LL_EDITOR=<photo-uuid> LL_SECTIONS=light:highwhites; LL_MASKGRADE=first seeds two masks (a photo can carry a grade too). Geometry verified 2026-09-13 against the running Debug build (1× capture, light appearance forced per process) on the interval bench shoot — the same rail; the photo pane here is the layout with hasTimeline false.
